qe: What is the structural and functional filtration unit of the human kidney?
qh: मानव वृक्क (Kidney) की संरचनात्मक और कार्यात्मक निस्पंदन इकाई क्या है?
e: Concept: Kidney ka sabse chhota kaam-wala hissa (structural + functional unit) Nephron hai - ek kidney me lagbhag 1 lakh se 1.3 lakh nephron hote hain. Har nephron me do hisse hote hain: pehla 'renal corpuscle' (Bowman's capsule + glomerulus - yahan khoon se paani aur waste chhan jata hai) aur doosra 'tubular system' (PCT, Loop of Henle, DCT - jahan zaroori cheezein wapas khoon me jati hain). Baaki teen alag units hain: Neuron brain ka, Hepatocyte liver ka, aur Alveolus phephde ka. Exam point: 'Kidney ka filtration unit = Nephron (ek kidney me ~1 million/hazaarfon)'.

qe: Which of the following is the primary nitrogenous waste product excreted by human kidneys?
qh: मानव वृक्क द्वारा उत्सर्जित किया जाने वाला मुख्य नाइट्रोजनयुक्त अपशिष्ट उत्पाद कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Body me protein tootne se ek zehreela cheez 'ammonia' banti hai; liver usko 'urea' me badal deta hai (urea cycle se), jo ammonia se kam zeher wali hai aur paani ke saath nikal jaati hai. Isliye insaan ka mukhya nitrogenous waste Urea hai jo khoon se kidney chhant kar peshab me phenk deti hai. Baaki teen bhi nitrogenous waste hain par mukhya nahi: Creatinine (muscle ka normal waste, kidney function test me dekha jata hai), Uric acid (purine ka, kam paani me - gout/stones), Ammonia (ammonotelic animals - machhli me). Exam point: 'Insaan (ureotelic) ka mukhya waste = Urea; machhli = ammonia; saap/pakshi = uric acid'.

qe: The Bowman's capsule and the enclosed glomerular capillary network together constitute the:
qh: बोमन संपुट (Bowman's Capsule) और केशिका गुच्छ (Glomerulus) मिलकर क्या कहलाते हैं?
e: Concept: Nephron ke shuruaati hisse me ek cup jaisi thaili (Bowman's capsule) hoti hai jisme ek andar ghusa hua gol guchchha (glomerulus) hai - ye glomerulus ek khaas capillary hai jisme dabaav se khoon ka paani aur chhote molecules (urea, glucose, salts) chhan kar capsule me girte hain. Ye dono milkar ek functional unit banate hain jise Malpighian Body ya Renal Corpuscle kehte hain. Baaki teen alag iske aage ke hisse hain: Loop of Henle (nali), Renal Tubule (poori nali), Collecting Duct (aage ka sarln). Exam point: 'Bowman's capsule + Glomerulus = Malpighian body / Renal corpuscle'.

qe: In which segment of the nephron does the maximum obligatory reabsorption of water, electrolytes, and nutrients occur?
qh: नेफ्रॉन के किस भाग में जल, इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स और 100% ग्लूकोज का सर्वाधिक पुनः अवशोषण (Reabsorption) होता है?
e: Concept: Glomerulus se jo 'filtrate' (chhana hua dravya) banta hai usme glucose, amino acid, sodium, paani sab hota hai; isme se lagbhag 65-70% (bahut zyada hissa) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) me wapas khoon me chala jata hai - glucose aur amino acids to poora hi (100% tak) absorb ho jate hain, isliye healthy insaan ke peshab me sugar nahi hoti. Baaki teen kam reabsorption karte hain: Ascending loop of Henle (sirf salt), DCT (sirf selected ions), Collecting duct (paani - ADH se). Exam point: 'Sabse zyada reabsorption (65-70%) = PCT (glucose/amino acid yahin)'.

qe: Which neurohypophyseal hormone increases water permeability in the DCT and Collecting Duct to concentrate urine?
qh: नेफ्रॉन की डीसीटी और संग्रह नलिका में जल के पुनः अवशोषण को बढ़ाकर मूत्र को सांद्र बनाने वाला हार्मोन कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Kidney ka paani bachane ka kaam ek hormone se control hota hai - Antidiuretic Hormone (ADH/Vasopressin), jo pituitary ke peeche wale hisse se nikalta hai. Jab sharir me paani kam ho jata hai (dehydration) to ye hormone badhta hai aur DCT + Collecting Duct ko paani ke liye zyada permeable kar deta hai; paani filtrate se wapas khoon me chala jata hai aur peshab gaadha (concentrated) ban jata hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Oxytocin delivery ka, Aldosterone sodium ka (thoda paani saath), ANF ulta paani bahar nikalta hai. Exam point: 'Peshab gaadha karna = ADH (vasopressin); DCT + collecting duct me paani ka absorption'.

qe: A severe deficiency or lack of responsiveness to Antidiuretic Hormone (ADH) leads to which clinical disorder?
qh: एंटीडाययूरेटिक हार्मोन (ADH) की कमी से अत्यधिक मात्रा में पतला मूत्र आने वाला कौन सा रोग होता है?
e: Concept: ADH ka kaam hai kidney me paani rokna; agar ADH banna band ho jaye, ya kidney uske prati jawab dena band kar de, to collecting duct paani ko kho deta hai - insaan bahut zyada peshab (roz 5-20 litre tak) karta hai aur usko pyaas bar-bar lagti hai. Aisi bimari ko Diabetes Insipidus kehte hain; sugar normal hota hai (isliye 'insipidus' = fika). Baaki teen alag bimariyan hain: Addison's (adrenal kami), Diabetes Mellitus (insulin/sugar), Cushing's (cortisol zyada). Exam point: 'ADH nahi bana/kaam nahi karta = Diabetes Insipidus (bahut peshab, sugar normal)'.

qe: The descending limb of the Loop of Henle is physiologically unique because it is:
qh: हेनले लूप की अवरोही भुजा (Descending Limb) की क्या शारीरिक विशेषता है?
o: Permeable to water but almost impermeable to electrolytes
Impermeable to both water and salts
Impermeable to water but permeable to salts
e: Concept: Loop of Henle ka pehla hissa (descending limb) kidney ka wo khaas hissa hai jisme sirf paani nikal sakta hai - bahar ke medulla me na-mak (salt) zyada hone ki wajah se paani osmosis se bahar nikal jata hai (kyunki membrane paani ke liye permeable hai) - par salt (electrolyte) andar nahi jata (impermeable). Isi wajah se filtrate andar jaate-jaate gaadha (concentrated) hota rehta hai, aur insaan ka urine concentrate hota hai. Baaki teen segments alag kaam karte hain: PCT me glucose absorb hota hai, aur ascending limb paani ke liye na-permeable hai par salt nikalti hai. Exam point: 'Descending loop = paani ke liye permeable, salt ke liye nahi (urine concentrate karta hai)'.

qe: The thick ascending limb of the Loop of Henle is called the 'Diluting Segment' because it:
qh: हेनले लूप की आरोही भुजा (Ascending Limb) को 'तनुकारी खंड' क्यों कहा जाता है?
o: Secretes urea directly into the lumen
Actively transports salts out while remaining impermeable to water
e: Concept: Loop of Henle ka doosra hissa (thick ascending limb) paani ke liye poora band (impermeable) hota hai, par wahan sodium aur chloride ko actively bahar (filtrate se blood me) nikala jata hai. Kyunki paani nikal nahi paata par salt nikal jata hai, filtrate dheere-dheere patla (dilute) ho jata hai - isliye ise 'Diluting Segment' kehte hain. Baaki teen galat hain: 90% paani ka reabsorption PCT me hota hai, filtration glomerulus me, aur urea ka secretion alag hai. Exam point: 'Diluting segment = thick ascending limb (salt bahar, paani andar hi rehta hai)'.

qe: Which major blood vessel delivers waste-laden systemic arterial blood directly into the kidney for filtration?
qh: कौन सी रक्त वाहिका नाइट्रोजनी कचरे से युक्त रक्त को शुद्धिकरण के लिए वृक्क (Kidney) में लाती है?
e: Concept: Kidney ko saaf karne ke liye khoon chahiye hota hai; ye khoon Aorta se nikal kar Renal Artery ke through kidney me pahunchta hai (ek insaan me kidney ko total cardiac output ka 20% - matlab har minute ~1.2 litre blood milta hai), phir wahan se chhant kar safa khoon Renal Vein se bahar jaata hai. Baaki teen ye kaam nahi karte: Renal Vein safa khoon le jaati hai, Inferior Vena Cava badi vein hai, Hepatic Portal Vein aanto se liver jati hai. Exam point: 'Kidney ME khoon laane wali = Renal Artery; wapas le jaane wali = Renal Vein'.

qe: The neural reflex process of voiding accumulated urine from the urinary bladder through the urethra is:
qh: मूत्राशय में भरे मूत्र को तंत्रिका प्रतिवर्त द्वारा बाहर निकालने की प्रक्रिया क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Peshab ke nikalne ki process ko Micturition (ya urination/voiding) kehte hain; ye ek reflex hai - jab bladder me ~300-400 ml urine bhar jata hai to bladder ki deewar ki nerve brain ko signal bhejti hai, aur brain ke order par bladder ki detrusor muscle sikudti hai aur sphincter khulta hai. Baaki teen alag processes hain: Deglutition (nigla), Parturition (delivery), Defecation (stool) - inhe inke naam se alag rakho. Exam point: 'Peshab ka bahar nikalna = Micturition (bladder + sphincter ka reflex)'.

qe: The characteristic amber-yellow pigmentation of normal human urine is primarily caused by which breakdown pigment?
qh: सामान्य मानव मूत्र का हल्का पीला रंग हीमोग्लोबिन के किस अपघटन वर्णक (Pigment) के कारण होता है?
e: Concept: Bile me jo bilirubin hota hai, wo intestine me bacteria se ja kar urobilin me badal jata hai; iska ek hissa khoon me ja kar kidney se peshab me nikal jata hai - yahi Urochrome peshab ko halka peela (amber-yellow) rang deta hai. Agar peshab bilkul rang ya safed ho ya bahut gaadha laal-bhura ho to ye kidney/liver ka ishara ho sakta hai. Baaki teen alag pigments hain: Stercobilin stool ka rang, Melanin chamdi/baal ka, Bilirubin bile me (peshab ke rang ke liye aage urobilin chahiye). Exam point: 'Peshab ka peela rang = Urochrome (urobilin)'.

qe: What is the normal Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR) in a healthy adult human?
qh: एक स्वस्थ वयस्क मनुष्य में सामान्य ग्लोमेरुलर निस्पंदन दर (GFR) कितनी होती है?
e: Concept: Glomerular Filtration Rate (GFR) batata hai ki dono kidneys milkar ek minute me kitna plasma/filtrate banaati hain. Iska normal ~125 ml/minute hota hai - poore din me 180 litre (aur poore shareer ka sirf 5 litre khoon hai - matlab kidney khoon ko din me 36 baar chhanti hai!). Ye itni zyada matra ka pata chalta hai kaam jo chhanai ka hai; iska 99% wapas absorb ho jata hai. Baaki teen numbers galat hain. Exam point: 'Normal GFR = 125 ml/min (~180 L/day); GFR kam ho to kidney failure ka signal'.

qe: Which organisms are classified as 'Uricotelic' because they excrete nitrogenous waste as insoluble uric acid paste to conserve water?
qh: जल संरक्षण के लिए नाइट्रोजनी अपशिष्ट को पेस्ट के रूप में उत्सर्जित करने वाले 'यूरिकोटेलिक' (Uricotelic) प्राणी कौन से हैं?
e: Concept: Nitrogenous waste ke teen tarah ke jaanwar hote hain. Jaanwar jinka paani aasani se nahi milta (pakshi, sarisrip/reptiles, keede) wo ammonia ko 'uric acid' me badalte hain, jo paani me ghulta nahi - isliye ye thodi si paani ke saath gaadhe safed paste (crystalline pellet) ki tarah nikal jata hai. Ye system se paani bachta hai (warna uric acid stones bhi ban sakte the). Baaki teen aquatic/ureotelic hain: amphibians aur machhli (ammonia), protozoans, aur mammals (urea). Exam point: 'Uricotelic (paste/faeces me) = Pakshi, Reptiles, Keede; paani bachaane ke liye'.

qe: Specialized visceral epithelial cells lining the inner wall of Bowman's capsule with interdigitating pedicels are:
qh: बोमन संपुट की आंतरिक दीवार पर बारीक निस्पंदन छिद्र (Filtration Slits) बनाने वाली विशेष कोशिकाएं कौन सी हैं?
e: Concept: Glomerulus ki capillaries ke aas-paas Bowman's capsule ki andar ki parat par khaas cells hote hain - Podocytes (pad = pair, kyunki inke pair jaise 'pedicels' hote hain). Ye foot-like processes milkar filtration ke chhote-chhote chhed banate hain (filtration slits) - inke through sirf paani aur chhote molecules jaate hain, bade proteins aur blood cells nahi. Koi sa nuksaan (jaisa diabetes me) inhe kharab karta hai to urine me protein aa jata hai. Baaki teen alag cells hain: Juxtaglomerular cells renin banate hain, Mesangial cells support karte hain, Macula densa NaCl ka signal dete hain. Exam point: 'Bowman's capsule ke podocytes = filtration slits (protein ko rokte hain)'.

qe: The triangular, striated conical tissue masses situated within the renal medulla are known as:
qh: वृक्क के आंतरिक मेडुला भाग में स्थित शंक्वाकार पिरामिड जैसी संरचनाओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Kidney ka andar ka hissa (medulla) me shanku (cone) jaise teen gaukh rachana hoti hain - Renal (Medullary) Pyramids. Inke chaaron taraf cortex (bahari hissa) hota hai, aur pyramid ke nok (tip) ki taraf urine collect hokar nikalta hai (papillae -> calices -> pelvis). Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Renal Papillae pyramid ke nukile, Renal Columns of Bertin cortex ke bands jo pyramids ke beech jaate hain, aur Major Calyces urine collect karne wali badi naliyan (pelvis se pehle). Exam point: 'Kidney medulla ke cone/teekhe = Renal pyramids (~8-18 per kidney)'.

qe: The columns of cortical tissue extending downward between adjacent medullary pyramids are the:
qh: मेडुला पिरामिडों के बीच धँसे हुए कॉर्टेक्स के स्तंभों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Kidney ke andar cortex (bahari parat) ki cell bands kabhi-kabhi andar ki taraf jaakar medulla ke pyramids ke beech me ghusa jati hain - in 'cortex ke sthambhon' ko Renal Columns of Bertin kehte hain. Ye normal anatomy hai (bimari nahi). Baaki teen alag hain: Vasa Recta medulla me khaas capillary loops, Fibrous trabeculae connective tissue ki pattiyan, Minor Calyces pyramid ki taraf urine ikattha karne wali chhoti naliyan. Exam point: 'Pyramids ke beech ghusa cortex = Renal Columns of Bertin'.

qe: In clinical hemodialysis, which critical substance must be added to the patient's blood to prevent tubing thrombosis?
qh: हेमोडायलिसिस मशीन में रक्त भेजने से पहले नसों में खून का थक्का जमने से रोकने के लिए क्या मिलाया जाता है?
e: Concept: Dialysis me patient ka khoon ek machine ke plastic naliyon (tubing) me se guzarta hai; par khoon bahar ki nali me chaalta rehne par apne aap jam (thrombus) sakta hai. Isliye dialysis ke waqt blood me ek anticoagulant - Heparin - dala jata hai, taaki machine/nali me khoon na jam jaye. Baaki teen ulta kaam karte hain: Calcium chloride aur Thrombin clotting badhate hain, aur Vitamin K bhi clotting factors ke liye zaroori hai. Exam point: 'Dialyzer/nali me khoon jamne se rokne ke liye = Heparin (anticoagulant)'.

qe: The specialized sensory structure monitoring NaCl delivery in the DCT to control Renin secretion from JG cells is the:
qh: डीसीटी नलिका में सोडियम क्लोराइड की सांद्रता को मापकर रेनिन हार्मोन स्राव को नियंत्रित करने वाली कोशिकाएं कौन सी हैं?
e: Concept: Jeb sharir me BP girta hai ya sodium kam hota hai to kidney ke Juxtaglomerular (JG) cells Renin chhodte hain; par JG cells ko 'khabar' kaun deta hai? Answer: DCT me baithe khaas cells Macula Densa - ye filtrate me NaCl (salt) ki maatra ko 'sensor' ki tarah monitor karte hain aur salt kam ho to Renin nikalne ka signal dete hain. Baaki teen alag cells hain: Kupffer cells liver ke, Podocytes filtration ke, Detrusor myocytes bladder ki muscle. Exam point: 'DCT ka NaCl sensor = Macula densa (renin ka signal)'.

qe: Which powerful peptidergic vasoconstrictor is enzymatically activated by ACE following Renin release?
qh: रेनिन के स्राव के बाद रक्तचाप को तेजी से बढ़ाने वाला शक्तिशाली वाहिकासंकीर्णक (Vasoconstrictor) कौन सा है?
e: Concept: Renin liver ke 'Angiotensinogen' ko Angiotensin I me badalta hai; phir lungs me ACE enzyme use Angiotensin II me badal deta hai. Angiotensin II ek bahut tez vasoconstrictor hai (blood vessels ko sikodta hai, BP badhata hai) aur Aldosterone nikalne ka signal deta hai - isliye ye BP ka sabse bada 'badhao' hai (BP ki dawaen - ACE inhibitors - isi ko rokti hain). Baaki teen alag hain: Bradykinin BP ghataata hai, Angiotensinogen kaccha material hai, ANF BP ghataata hai. Exam point: 'Renin -> Angiotensin II (ACE se) = BP badhane wala + aldosterone ka signal'.

qe: What is the normal blood glucose renal plasma threshold beyond which glucosuria begins to manifest?
qh: रक्त में ग्लूकोज का वह अधिकतम स्तर (Renal Threshold) क्या है जिसके बाद मूत्र में ग्लूकोज रिसने लगता है?
e: Concept: Glomerulus se khoon chhanne par glucose bhi filtrate me aata hai, par PCT use poora wapas absorb kar leta hai - lekin is absorption ki ek 'had' (threshold) hoti hai: jab blood sugar ~180 mg/dL se upar chali jaye, to kidney ki carriers 'bharr' jati hain aur bacha hua glucose urine me nikal jata hai - ise Glycosuria (urine me sugar) kehte hain. Ye diabetes ke diagnose me kaam aata hai. Baaki teen values kami/zyada hain: 80-100 fasting normal hai (glycosuria nahi), 300 bahut upar. Exam point: 'Urine me sugar nikalne ka threshold = ~180 mg/dL blood glucose'.

qe: In which primary human organ does the biochemical Ornithine (Urea) cycle synthesize urea from toxic ammonia?
qh: अत्यधिक विषैले अमोनिया से यूरिया का निर्माण (ऑर्निथिन चक्र) शरीर के किस मुख्य अंग में होता है?
e: Concept: Ammonia (NH3) bahut zeher wali hai, isliye insaan usko seedha peshab se nahi nikaal sakta - liver ke hepatocytes ke andar ek cycle chalta hai (Ornithine/Urea cycle) jisme 2 ammonia + CO2 milkar 'Urea' ban jata hai, jo kam zeher wali hai aur kidney usse paani ke saath aasani se nikal deti hai. Isliye liver kharab (cirrhosis) ho to ammonia blood me badh jata hai aur brain ko numban (hepatic encephalopathy) banata hai. Baaki teen organs urea nahi banate: Pancreas, Bladder, Kidney (kidney sirf nikalta hai). Exam point: 'Urea banane ka factory = Liver (ornithine/urea cycle)'.

qe: What is the primary mineral composition responsible for the vast majority of human renal calculi (kidney stones)?
qh: अधिकांश मानव गुर्दे की पथरी (Kidney Stones) मुख्य रूप से किस रासायनिक यौगिक से बनी होती है?
e: Concept: Peshab me namak/paani kam aur 'kadvi' cheezein (oxalate, calcium, uric acid) zyada hone par ye crystals banakar thos ho jate hain - kidney stones (renal calculi). Sabse zyada (75-85%) stone Calcium Oxalate ke hote hain (chana, palak, tamatar, chukandar jaise oxalate wale khane + kam paani se); paani zyada peene se stone banne ka khatra kam ho jata hai. Baaki teen alag stones hain: Sodium urate (gout me), Magnesium carbonate (rare), Cholesterol (gallbladder me hota hai, kidney stone nahi). Exam point: 'Kidney stone ka sabse common type = Calcium Oxalate (~80%)'.

qe: The diagnostic presence of intact red blood cells in the microscopic examination of urine is termed:
qh: मूत्र की माइक्रोस्कोपिक जांच में रक्त या आरबीसी की उपस्थिति क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Urine me khoon ki saari (intact) laal koshikayein (RBC) nazar aana Hematuria kehlata hai - iska matlab hai urine ka koi hissa (kidney, ureter, bladder) me bleeding ho rahi hai; kaaran ho sakte hain: stone, infection, tumor, chot ya glomerular bimari. Baaki teen alag urine ke findings hain: Proteinuria (protein), Pyuria (pus/white cells), Ketonuria (ketone bodies). Exam point: 'Urine me laal koshikayein = Hematuria (khoon aana)'.

qe: Which clinical condition is defined by acute failure of the kidneys producing less than 100 mL of urine per day?
qh: किडनी की विफलता के कारण दिन भर में 100 मिलीलीटर से भी कम मूत्र बनने की गंभीर स्थिति को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Kidneys ka mukhya kaam hai din me lagbhag 1-1.5 litre (aur normal 800 ml - 2 litre) urine banana; agar koi mareez ek din me 100 ml se bhi kam urine banata hai to us condition ko Anuria kehte hain - ye usually acute kidney failure/dialysis ka signal hai aur ise turant dekhna padta hai. Baaki teen alag shabd hain: Dysuria (peshab me jalan), Nocturia (raat me bar-bar peshab), Polyuria (bahut zyada peshab). Exam point: 'Peshab <100 ml/day = Anuria (kidney failure ka khatra)'.

qe: Which nitrogenous waste substance exhibits the highest biological cellular toxicity and necessitates the greatest volume of water for excretion?
qh: कौन सा नाइट्रोजनी अपशिष्ट सबसे अधिक विषैला होता है और इसके उत्सर्जन के लिए सबसे अधिक जल की आवश्यकता होती है?
e: Concept: Ammonia (NH3) sabse zyada zeher wala nitrogenous waste hai; ise sharir se ek gram nikalne ke liye 300-500 ml paani chahiye, isliye jo jaanwar paani bacha sakte hain wo ammonia ko urea (kam zeher) ya uric acid (ghulta nahi) me badal dete hain. Iska seedha matlab hai: ammonia ki excretion me sabse zyada paani lagta hai (isliye machhliyaan ammonia seedha nikal deti hain, wahan paani ki kami nahi). Baaki teen kam zeher hain ya paani bachate hain: Uric acid (maximum paani bachata hai), Urea, Hippuric acid. Exam point: 'Maximum toxic + maximum paani chahne wala waste = Ammonia'.

qe: Which cardiac hormone directly opposes the RAAS mechanism by promoting natriuresis, diuresis, and vasodilation to lower BP?
qh: रक्तचाप बढ़ने पर हृदय के अलिंद द्वारा स्रावित होने वाला कौन सा हार्मोन रेनिन-एंजियोटेंसिन तंत्र का विरोध कर रक्तचाप घटाता है?
e: Concept: Jab BP badhta hai ya blood volume (paani) badh jata hai to dil ki atria me bhi 'kheench' aa jati hai - is par atria ke myocytes ANF (Atrial Natriuretic Factor) chhodte hain. Ye hormone RAAS (renin-angiotensin-aldosterone) ka ulta kaam karta hai: kidney se sodium (natriuresis) aur paani (diuresis) bahar nikalta hai aur blood vessels ko faila deta hai - net BP kam. Baaki teen is axis me BP badhate hain: ADH (paani roko), Aldosterone (sodium roko), Thyroxine (metabolism - BP nahi). Exam point: 'RAAS ka natural uliuli = ANF (dil se, BP ghataata hai)'.

qe: Hairpin-shaped capillary loops running parallel to the long loops of Henle in juxtamedullary nephrons are called:
qh: मेडुला में हेनले लूप के समानांतर चलने वाली हेयरपिन के आकार की रक्त केशिकाओं को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Juxtamedullary nephrons (jo medulla tak lambi jaati hain) me loop of Henle ke saath-saath khaas 'hairpin' (akadi hui medially) capillary loops bhi chalte hain - inhe Vasa Recta kehte hain. Ye medulla me ghadhepa pani aur salt ka exchange karke medullary salt ko banaaye rakhti hain, jisse peshab concentrate hota hai (aur ise 'counter-current' system ka hissa maana jata hai). Baaki teen alag vessels hain: Peritubular cortical plexus cortex me, Afferent arterioles glomerulus me jaate hain, Interlobular veins khoon le jaati hain. Exam point: 'Medulla me loop of Henle ke saath capillary loops = Vasa recta (urine concentrate karne me madad)'.

qe: Cortical nephrons constitute approximately 85% of total human nephrons and are anatomically characterized by:
qh: मानव वृक्क में 85% पाए जाने वाले कॉर्टिकल नेफ्रॉन की मुख्य पहचान क्या होती है?
o: Short loops of Henle barely dipping into outer medulla with absent/reduced vasa recta
Extremely long loops of Henle extending to renal papilla
e: Concept: Kidney ke nephrons do prakar ke hote hain: Cortical nephrons (85%) jinke loop of Henle chhote hote hain aur medulla me theek se ghusa hi nahi (outer medulla me thoda sa) - inke saath vasa recta bhi bahut kam/na ke barabar hoti hai, isliye ye urine ko zyada concentrate nahi kar paate. Juxtamedullary nephrons (15%) lambi loops wale hote hain jo gehare medulla tak jaate hain aur concentrate urine banate hain. Baaki teen descriptions galat hain (Bowman's capsule/PCT/lambe loops to cortical nephron me hote hain). Exam point: 'Cortical nephrons = 85%, short loops (concentration zyada nahi); juxtamedullary = long loops'.

qe: What clinical term designates the chronic accumulation of toxic urea and nitrogenous waste in systemic circulation due to renal failure?
qh: गुर्दे की विफलता के कारण रक्त में यूरिया और नाइट्रोजनी कचरे के अत्यधिक जमाव की विषाक्त स्थिति को क्या कहते हैं?
e: Concept: Jab kidneys waste nikalna band kar deti hain to urea aur nitrogenous waste blood me jama hote rehte hain - is condition ko Uremia kehte hain; isse ulti, bhookh na lagna, kamzori, khujli, saans me muh ki badbu aur aage chal kar brain me confusion (encephalopathy) tak hota hai; iska ilaaj dialysis ya transplant hai. Baaki teen alag urine findings hain: Ketonuria (ketone), Glycosuria (sugar), Hematuria (khoon). Exam point: 'Blood me urea/waste ka jama = Uremia (kidney failure ka result)'.

qe: What is the typical physiological Net Filtration Pressure (NFP) driving ultrafiltration across the glomerular membrane?
qh: ग्लोमेरुलर झिल्ली के पार अल्ट्रा-फिल्ट्रेशन कराने वाला सामान्य शुद्ध निस्पंदन दाब (NFP) लगभग कितना होता है?
e: Concept: Glomerulus me teen dabaav ek saath kaam karte hain: (1) blood pressure jo filtration karata hai (~60 mmHg), (2) capsule ke andar ka back pressure (15 mmHg) aur (3) proteins ka osmotic pressure (25 mmHg) - dono peeche khinchte hain. Net bacha hua pressure = 60 - (15+25) = lagbhag 10-20 mmHg, yahi Net Filtration Pressure hai. Baaki teen values galat hain: 60 mmHg sirf ek component, 0 nahi, aur 120-140 to BP hai. Exam point: 'Net filtration pressure = ~10-20 mmHg (BP - back pressure - osmotic pressure)'.

qe: The subjective clinical sensation of burning, painful, or difficult urination is medically diagnosed as:
qh: पेशाब करते समय दर्द, जलन या कठिनाई होने की स्थिति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Concept: Peshab ke waqt jalan, chubhan ya takleef ko Dysuria kehte hain - ye urinary tract infection (UTI) ka sabse aam lakshan hai (aur kidney stone me bhi hota hai); khaas kar auraton me ye zyada hoti hai kyunki urethra chhoti hoti hai. Baaki teen alag shabd hain: Nocturia (raat me peshab), Oliguria (peshab kam), Polyuria (peshab bahut zyada). Exam point: 'Peshab me jalan/dard = Dysuria (UTI ka lakshan)'.

qe: Voluntary control over the timing of micturition is exerted specifically by which anatomical structure?
qh: इच्छाशक्ति (Voluntary Control) द्वारा पेशाब को रोकने का नियंत्रण किस संरचना द्वारा किया जाता है?
o: External Urethral Sphincter (Skeletal muscle under somatic control)
e: Concept: Peshab ka control do sphincter (dawaaze) karte hain: (1) Internal urethral sphincter - smooth muscle (involuntary), jo bina kaha band rehta hai, aur (2) External urethral sphincter - skeletal muscle (voluntary), jise hum apni marzi se khol-band kar sakte hain. Isliye hum peshab ki 'thongs' control kar sakte hain - sote waqt ya sharab peene par bahut kam/sharab me ye control kam ho jata hai. Baaki teen automatic (involuntary) hain: Detrusor muscle, Internal sphincter, Ureteric junction. Exam point: 'Peshab ka marzi se control = External urethral sphincter (skeletal muscle)'.

qe: The presence of significant serum albumin protein in the urine (Albuminuria) reflects pathological barrier disruption of the:
qh: मूत्र में एल्ब्यूमिन प्रोटीन का लीक होना (Albuminuria) किस संरचना के क्षतिग्रस्त होने का संकेत है?
o: Glomerular capillary endothelial and podocyte filtration barrier
e: Concept: Glomerulus ki filtration wall ki teen paratein hoti hain: (1) endothelial cells, (2) basement membrane, aur (3) podocytes ke filtration slits. Ye teeno milkar bade proteins (albumin) aur blood cells ko rok dete hain. Jab ye barrier (khaas kar diabetes, BP ya autoimmune - nephrotic syndrome) me kharab ho jata hai, to albumin urine me nikal jata hai (Albuminuria) - isse khoon me albumin kam hota hai aur pairon-sharir me sujan (edema) aa jati hai. Baaki teen jagah is bimari se juda nahi: bladder, ureter, urethra. Exam point: 'Urine me albumin = glomerular filtration barrier ka kharab hona'.

qe: What biological mechanism allows desert rodents like the kangaroo rat to excrete extremely hypertonic urine?
qh: कंगारू चूहे जैसे मरुस्थलीय जीव अत्यधिक सांद्रित मूत्र त्यागने के लिए किस शारीरिक विशेषता का उपयोग करते हैं?
o: Exceptionally long loops of Henle in juxtamedullary nephrons generating deep medullary hyperosmolarity
e: Concept: Desert animals (jaise kangaroo rat) ko paani bahut kam milta hai, isliye unka peshab bahut gaadha (hypertonic) hota hai - ye kaam unke 'extra-long loops of Henle' (juxtamedullary nephrons) karte hain, jo medulla me bahut gehra jaakar bahut zyada salt (hyperosmolar) banate hain; is wajah se collecting duct se zyada paani wapas khinch jata hai. Baaki teen galat hain: glomearuli ki kami ya collecting duct ka na hona (kabhi nahi hota) aur ammonia liquid form me. Exam point: 'Gaadha urine banana = lambi loops of Henle (desert animals me)'.

qe: Protonephridia containing ciliated 'Flame Cells' function as primitive osmoregulatory excretory organs in:
qh: ज्वाला कोशिकाओं (Flame Cells) वाले प्रोटोनेफ्रिडिया किस अकशेरुकी प्राणी संघ के प्राथमिक उत्सर्जी अंग हैं?
e: Concept: Flatworms (Platyhelminthes) jaise Planaria aur tapeworm me ek saral excretory system hota hai - Protonephridia, jiske siron par 'flame cells' (khaas pulsating cilia wali jhilanga cells) hoti hain. Ye cilia ka chaabuk lagakar waste-paani ko naliyon me dhakelte hain aur usse bahar nikaal dete hain; ye mainly osmoregulation (paani ka balance) ka kaam karte hain. Baaki teen alag organs wale group hain: Arthropoda (Malpighian tubules), Echinodermata (bina khaas organ), Annelida (nephridia). Exam point: 'Flame cells/Protonephridia = Flatworms (Planaria/tapeworm)'.

qe: Malpighian tubules opening into the junction between midgut and hindgut serve as excretory organs in:
qh: मैलपीघियन नलिकाएं (Malpighian Tubules) किन प्राणियों का मुख्य उत्सर्जी अंग हैं?
e: Concept: Insects (Arthropoda) ke pet me patli-patar naliyon ka jo guchchha hota hai, unhe Malpighian tubules kehte hain; ye midgut aur hindgut ke jod par khulti hain aur khoon (haemolymph) se uric acid aur waste khinch kar hindgut me chhod deti hain, jahan paani wapas absorb hokar waste gaadhe paste ki tarah nikal jata hai (paani bachane ke liye). Baaki teen groups ke alag organs hain: Molluscs (nephridia), Crustaceans (antennal/green glands), Coelenterates (koi vishesh organ nahi). Exam point: 'Insects (tiddi/cockroach) ke excretory organs = Malpighian tubules'.

qe: Antennal or Green Glands execute nitrogenous waste excretion and osmoregulation in which animal group?
qh: हरी ग्रंथियां या एंटीनल ग्रंथियां (Green Glands) किन जीवों में उत्सर्जन का कार्य करती हैं?
e: Concept: Jheenga, crab jaise crustaceans ke sar (head) me 'antennal glands' (jise green glands bhi kehte hain) hote hain - ye nitrogenous waste (ammonia/urea) aur paani-salt ka balance sambhalte hain, aur unka nikalne ka rasta saamne ki taraf paas se khulta hai. Ye 'green glands' apne khaas green rang se pehchane jate hain. Baaki teen groups alag organs rakhte hain: Arachnids (coxal glands), Insects (Malpighian tubules), Nematodes (renette cells). Exam point: 'Crustaceans (prawns/crab) = Antennal/green glands'.

qe: Metanephridia with ciliated nephrostomes arranged segmentally serve as excretory structures in:
qh: खंडीय व्यवस्था वाले नेफ्रीडिया (Nephridia) किस जीव के उत्सर्जी अंग हैं?
e: Concept: Earthworm (Annelida) me har segment me ek-ek jodi khaas naliyan hoti hain - Metanephridia - jo ciliated funnel (nephrostome) se coelomic fluid (body cavity ka dravya) leti hain, usme se zaroori cheezein wapas absorb karti hain aur baaki waste ko bahar nikaal deti hain; isliye ye excretion aur osmoregulation dono karti hain. Baaki teen groups alag hain: Flatworms (flame cells), Cnidarians (koi vishesh organ nahi), Insects (Malpighian tubules). Exam point: 'Kechua (Annelida) = Metanephridia (har segment me ciliated funnel)'.

qe: What pathological mechanism produces 'Ketonuria' (spillover of acetoacetate and beta-hydroxybutyrate into urine)?
qh: मूत्र में कीटोन बॉडीज का आना (Ketonuria) किस चयापचय विकार का मुख्य नैदानिक लक्षण है?
o: Uncontrolled Diabetes Mellitus or prolonged starvation with massive fat beta-oxidation
e: Concept: Jab sharir me insulin kaam nahi karta (uncontrolled diabetes) ya insaan bahut lambe samay tak bhookha rehta hai, to cells glucose nahi jala paati aur 'emergency fuel' ke liye fat (charbi) todna shuru kar dete hain - fat ke is tez beta-oxidation se 'ketone bodies' (acetoacetate, beta-hydroxybutyrate) bante hain; jab ye zyada ho jate hain to urine me nikal aate hain - ise Ketonuria kehte hain (aur Type 1 diabetes me ye emergency/DKA ka signal hai). Baaki teen iske kaaran nahi hain: thyroid badhna, zyada namak, kidney stone. Exam point: 'Urine me ketone bodies = uncontrolled diabetes ya lambi bhookh (fat ka tez tootna)'.

qe: The presence of pus, purulent exudate, or degenerate neutrophils in the urine indicates urinary tract infection and is termed:
qh: मूत्र में मवाद (Pus) या अत्यधिक मृत श्वेत रक्त कोशिकाओं (WBCs) का आना क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Urine me pus (mawaad) - yaani bade matra me white blood cells aur unka tubes (degenerate neutrophils) - nikalna Pyuria kehlata hai; yahi urinary tract infection (UTI) ka khaas sign hai (jaise cystitis, pyelonephritis) aur isi wajah se urine dhundhla-badbudar hota hai. Ise test karne ke liye urine culture aur sensitivity kiya jata hai. Baaki teen alag urine findings hain: Glycosuria (sugar), Albuminuria (protein), Hematuria (khoon). Exam point: 'Urine me pus/WBC = Pyuria (UTI ka seedha lakshan)'.

qe: The notched concave medial indentation of each human kidney through which the renal artery, vein, nerves, and ureter pass is the:
qh: वृक्क की भीतरी अवतल सतह पर स्थित वह खांच (Notch) जहाँ से रक्त वाहिकाएं और मूत्रवाहिनी प्रवेश करती हैं, क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Dono kidneys ka andar ki taraf (medial) ek dhruba (notch/gadha) hota hai jise Renal Hilum kehte hain - isi ek jagah se renal artery (andar khoon laati), renal vein (bahar khoon le jaati), nerves, lymphatic aur ureter (peshab ki nali) nikalte hain. Isi wajah se kidney ka 'dwaar' kaha jata hai. Baaki teen alag hain: Cortex bahari parat, Major calyx andar ki badi nali, Renal pelvis ureter ka shuruaati chaudi hissa. Exam point: 'Kidney ka dwaar (artery/vein/ureter nikalne ki jagah) = Renal Hilum'.

qe: The funnel-shaped dilated proximal end of the ureter situated inside the renal sinus is the:
qh: वृक्क के भीतर स्थित वह कीप के आकार का भाग जो मूत्र को इकट्ठा करके मूत्रवाहिनी में भेजता है:
e: Concept: Kidney ke andar chhote calyces urine collect karke ek bade funnel (kund) me daalte hain, jise Renal Pelvis kehte hain - yahi aage jaakar ureter (patli nali) ban jata hai jo peshab ko bladder tak le jati hai. Iska aakar funnel (kidney-shaped) hai, isliye 'pyelos' (kund) naam pada. Baaki teen alag hisse hain: Major calyx pelvis se pehle ki nali, Bowman's capsule nephron ka hissa, Medullary pyramid banaawat. Exam point: 'Urine ka bada funnel jo ureter me badalta hai = Renal pelvis'.

qe: The tough, fibrous peritoneal serous membrane enclosing and anchoring the kidneys to the posterior abdominal wall is the:
qh: किडनी और पेट के आंतरिक अंगों को ढकने और सुरक्षित रखने वाली बाहरी सुरक्षात्मक झिल्ली क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Dono kidneys pet ke peeche ki taraf (retroperitoneal) baithe hote hain aur unke upar ek moti, majboot jhilli ka aavaran hota hai jo unhe apni jagah pakde rakhta hai aur chot se bachata hai; ise peritoneum (renal fascia/peritoneal serous membrane) ke naam se joda jata hai. Baaki teen doosre angon ke cover hain: Meninges (brain), Pericardium (heart), Pleura (lungs). Exam point: 'Kidney ka aavaran/anchor = Peritoneum (retroperitoneal)'; 'heart = pericardium, lungs = pleura, brain = meninges'.

qe: The smooth muscular tunic comprising the thick wall of the urinary bladder is the:
qh: मूत्राशय की मोटी दीवार बनाने वाली अनैच्छिक चिकनी पेशी (Smooth Muscle) कौन सी है?
e: Concept: Urinary bladder ek thaile jaisi pichkari hai jiski deewar ki mukhya muscle ko Detrusor muscle kehte hain; jab peshab bahar karna ho to ye muscle poori tarah akud kar sikudti hai aur bladder ka andar ka dabaav badhaa deti hai, jisse peshab urethra me dhakka khata hai. Baaki teen alag muscles hain: Cremaster (testis), Dartos (scrotum), Pectinate (heart ke atria ka hissa). Exam point: 'Bladder ki mukhya (thaili dabane wali) muscle = Detrusor muscle'.

qe: What physiological mechanism explains why healthy humans produce higher urine volumes in winter compared to hot summers?
qh: सर्दियों में गर्मियों की तुलना में शरीर अधिक मात्रा में मूत्र क्यों विसर्जित करता है?
o: Enhanced GFR driven by increased cardiac rate
Reduced cutaneous perspiration (sweating) shifting fluid volume balance entirely to renal excretion
e: Concept: Sardi (winter) me pasina (sweating) kam hota hai kyunki chamdi ko thanda rehne ki zaroorat nahi hoti - isliye sharir ka paani aur excess fluid ka nikalne ka mukhya rasta kidney ban jata hai, isliye peshab zyada aati hai. Ulta garmi me pasina bahut nikalta hai aur peshab kam. Baaki teen galat hain: ADH band nahi hota, GFR badhne se aisa nahi hota, aur aldosterone ka koi aisa role nahi. Exam point: 'Sardi me peshab zyada = pasina kam aana (paani kidney ke raste nikalta hai)'.

qe: The physiological pH range of freshly voided normal human urine is typically:
qh: ताजे सामान्य मानव मूत्र का औसत pH मान कितना होता है?
o: Identical to blood plasma at exactly 7.4
e: Concept: Peshab ka pH fix nahi hota, wo khane-peene par badalta hai - normal range 4.5 se 8.0 tak hoti hai, aur aam taur par halka tezabi (average ~6.0) hota hai; mansahari khana pH ghataata hai aur sabziyan badhati hain. Baaki teen ranges galat hain: 8.5-9.5 bahut alkaline (sabun jaisa), 7.4 khoon ka pH hai (urine ka nahi), aur 1.5-2.5 pet ka HCl hai. Exam point: 'Normal urine pH = 4.5-8.0 (average ~6, halka acidic)'.

qe: Which accessory excretory structures in human skin eliminate squalene, sterols, waxes, and triglycerides?
qh: त्वचा में पाए जाने वाले कौन से अंग सीबम (तेल) के माध्यम से मोम, हाइड्रोकार्बन और स्टेरोल का उत्सर्जन करते हैं?
e: Concept: Chamdi me do tarah ki glands pasine aur tel se judi hain. Sebaceous (oil) glands baal ke saath khulti hain aur ek tel wala padarth (sebum) chhodti hain, jisme squalene, sterols, waxes aur triglycerides hote hain - ye chamdi ko loonch (moisturize) karti hai aur paani udne se rokti hai; iski zyada ban se muhase (acne) hote hain. Baaki teen alag glands hain: Eccrine sweat glands sirf pasina (paani+salt), Ceruminous glands kaan ka maail (wax), Apocrine glands body odour se jude. Exam point: 'Skin se tel (squalene/wax/triglyceride) chhodne wali = Sebaceous (oil) glands'.

qe: The specialized medical branch dedicated to the physiology, disease pathology, and dialysis management of the kidneys is:
qh: वृक्क (गुर्दे) की संरचना, कार्यों और उसके रोगों के अध्ययन की चिकित्सा शाखा क्या कहलाती है?
e: Concept: Kidney ke structure, bimari aur dialysis ka poora study ek hi branch me hota hai - Nephrology (nephros = kidney); nephrologist kidney bimariyon ki dawa se ilaaj karte hain aur dialysis bhi karte hain. Baaki teen alag branches hain: Neurology (brain/nerves), Urology (urinary tract ki surgery - kidney/bladder ke operations, peshab ki bimariyan), Endocrinology (hormones). Exam point: 'Kidney ki medical branch = Nephrology' (surgery wali = Urology).

qe: Which of the following describes the tubular secretion mechanism in the distal convoluted tubule (DCT)?
qh: रक्त के pH और आयनिक संतुलन को बनाए रखने के लिए डीसीटी (DCT) में सक्रिय रूप से किन आयनों का स्राव (Tubular Secretion) किया जाता है?
o: Active secretion of Potassium (K+), Hydrogen (H+), and Ammonia into the filtrate
Absorption of glucose and amino acids
e: Concept: Nephron ka aakhri hissa (DCT) 'fine tuning' karta hai - yahan se paani/sodium absorb hota hai aur jo cheezein blood me zyada hain unhe 'tubular secretion' se filtrate me daala jata hai: Potassium (K+), Hydrogen (H+) aur Ammonia; isse khoon ka acid-base balance aur potassium ka balance banta hai (aur isi wajah se potassium level bighadne par heart par asar padta hai). Baaki teen galat hain: glucose/amino acid absorption PCT me hota hai, aur protein/albumin normally absorb nahi hote (wo blood me hi rehte hain). Exam point: 'DCT ka kaam = K+, H+ aur ammonia ka secretion (acid-base balance)'.

qe: The primary clinical danger of acute, untreated hyperkalemia (excess serum potassium) in renal failure is:
qh: किडनी फेल होने पर रक्त में पोटेशियम का स्तर अत्यधिक बढ़ जाने (Hyperkalemia) का सबसे बड़ा घातक खतरा क्या है?
o: Fatal cardiac arrhythmias and sudden cardiac arrest
e: Concept: Kidney fail (acute) ho jaye to potassium (K+) blood me jama hone lagta hai - Hyperkalemia. Kyunki heart ke electrical system par potassium ka seedha asar hota hai, ye heart ki rhythm todkar fatal arrhythmia ya sudden cardiac arrest (dil ka ruk jana) paida karta hai; isliye aise mareez ko turant ilaaj (calcium gluconate, insulin-glucose, dialysis) chahiye. Baaki teen organs par ye aisa asar nahi karta: phephde, liver, aankh. Exam point: 'Hyperkalemia me sabse bada khatra = heart ka ruk jana (cardiac arrest)'.
